solutions.title: Backtracking search
solutions.strategy: Explore simple paths from the start and keep the shortest path to food.

timeComplexity.explanation: A path can branch to four neighbors until cells are exhausted.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack and visited grid can cover every cell.

solutions.title: Breadth-first search
solutions.strategy: Run BFS from the start so the first food cell reached is shortest.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each grid cell is enqueued at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue and visited set can store every open cell.
